notes: Cover page of the sitting: no speech at all, so utterance_starts is empty and anything the parser attributes to a speaker here is a false positive. The whole page is the title block plus the roll of senators present; the roll is a list of names, not an utterance, and it carries no stenographer's dash, so I did not record it as an event either. There is no running dateline header and no 'Dirección General de Taquígrafos' footer on this page — the page furniture is the masthead instead. Typographic irregularities in the roll: accents are applied inconsistently in the surnames (MARTÍNEZ PELÁEZ and SÁEZ are accented, while MARTINEZ ALMUDEVAR and RODRIGUEZ are printed with no accent at all); 'MIKKELSEN-LÖTH' carries a diaeresis.
